ceu: ✦ The opposition between Mercury and Mars

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between friendships and romance. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your career and family. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and money. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between relationships and your image. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between romance and friendships. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between family and your career. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between money and intimacy. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
From {H:1802017905000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your image and relationships. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.
